entry.en: For tourist stays of up to 90 days, your passport must expire after the date you leave South Korea.
entry.es: Para estancias turísticas de hasta 90 días, tu pasaporte debe vencer después de la fecha en que salgas de Corea del Sur.
entry.quote: To enter South Korea as a tourist for up to 90 days, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ after the date you are leaving South Korea.

entry.en: You can enter for up to 90 days for short-term business or tourism, and you must have an onward or return ticket.
entry.es: Puedes entrar hasta 90 días por negocios breves o turismo, y debes tener un billete de continuación o de regreso.
entry.quote: You can enter South Korea for up to 90 days for short-term business or tourism. You must have an onward or return ticket.

entry.en: Travellers without a K-ETA need to fill out a free e-Arrival Card online.
entry.es: Quienes no tengan K-ETA deben completar en línea una tarjeta de llegada electrónica gratuita.
entry.quote: If you do not have a K-ETA, you need to fill out a free e-Arrival Card online.

entry.en: The e-Arrival card can be submitted online within 72 hours before arrival and is free.
entry.es: La tarjeta de llegada electrónica se puede enviar en línea hasta 72 horas antes de llegar y es gratuita.
entry.quote: You can submit the e-Arrival card within 72 hours (3 days) before your arrival in Korea. There is no fee to submit the e-Arrival card.

entry.en: Foreign nationals must submit an entry declaration form (arrivals card) to the immigration officer on arrival.
entry.es: Los extranjeros deben entregar al oficial de inmigración un formulario de declaración de entrada (tarjeta de llegada) al llegar.
entry.quote: Foreign nationals entering South Korea are required to submit an entry declaration form (arrivals card) to the immigration officer upon arrival.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Crime against foreigners is rare but thefts occur, so take extra care of passports, cards and money in crowded areas and places like Itaewon.
safety.es: El delito contra extranjeros es raro pero hay robos ocasionales, así que cuida pasaportes, tarjetas y dinero en zonas concurridas y lugares como Itaewon.
safety.quote: Crime against foreigners is rare but there are occasional thefts. Take extra care of passports, credit cards and money in crowded areas and in areas visited by foreigners, such as Itaewon.

safety.en: There have been cases of assault, including sexual assault, particularly around bars and nightlife areas.
safety.es: Ha habido casos de agresión, incluida agresión sexual, sobre todo en torno a bares y zonas de vida nocturna.
safety.quote: While most reported crimes are thefts, there have been cases of assault, including sexual assault, particularly around bars and nightlife areas.

safety.en: Tension and the security situation on the Korean Peninsula can change with little notice.
safety.es: La tensión y la situación de seguridad en la península de Corea pueden cambiar con poco aviso.
safety.quote: The level of tension and the security situation on the Korean Peninsula can change with little notice.

safety.en: Public demonstrations are common, particularly when political tensions are elevated.
safety.es: Las manifestaciones públicas son comunes, sobre todo cuando aumentan las tensiones políticas.
safety.quote: Public demonstrations in South Korea are common, particularly at times of elevated political tensions.

safety.en: Illegal drug offences can bring a long jail sentence and heavy fines, even for personal use of small amounts of marijuana.
safety.es: Los delitos de drogas pueden acarrear largas penas de cárcel y multas elevadas, incluso por consumo personal de pequeñas cantidades de marihuana.
safety.quote: you can face a long jail sentence and heavy fines. This applies even to personal use of small amounts of marijuana.

safety.en: Illegal taxis are a problem and operate even from the airport.
safety.es: Los taxis ilegales son un problema y operan incluso desde el aeropuerto.
safety.quote: Illegal taxis are a problem and run even from the airport.

health.en: Medical and dental care is usually of a good standard but can be expensive, and staff may not speak English.
health.es: La atención médica y dental suele ser de buen nivel pero puede ser cara, y el personal quizá no hable inglés.
health.quote: Medical and dental care in South Korea is usually of a good standard, but can be expensive. Staff may not speak English.

health.en: Air pollution, including yellow dust, is common, especially during spring.
health.es: La contaminación del aire, incluido el polvo amarillo, es común, sobre todo en primavera.
health.quote: Air pollution, including yellow dust pollution, is common, especially during spring months.

health.en: Tap water is described as perfectly safe to drink, though locals often boil or filter it to remove the chlorine smell.
health.es: Se describe el agua del grifo como totalmente segura para beber, aunque los locales suelen hervirla o filtrarla para quitar el olor a cloro.
health.quote: Tap water in South Korea is perfectly safe to drink, although you may want to follow the local habits of boiling and filtering if only to get rid of the chlorine smell.

health.en: There are no official vaccinations required or recommended for visitors, but hepatitis A is known throughout the country.
health.es: No hay vacunas oficiales exigidas ni recomendadas para visitantes, pero la hepatitis A existe en todo el país.
health.quote: Although there are no official vaccinations that are required or recommended for visitors, hepatitis A is known throughout the country

health.en: You cannot simply go to a hospital's emergency department and expect to get treatment.
health.es: No puedes simplemente acudir a urgencias de un hospital y esperar ser atendido.
health.quote: One thing that surprises non-Koreans is that you cannot simply go to a hospital's emergency department and expect to get treatment.

health.en: Take an English-language prescription from your home doctor for both prescription and non-prescription medicines.
health.es: Lleva una receta en inglés de tu médico para tus medicamentos con y sin receta.
health.quote: Take an English language prescription from your doctor at home for both your prescription drugs and non-prescription medicines.

help.en: Emergency numbers are 119 for ambulance and fire and 112 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 119 para ambulancia y bomberos y 112 para la policía.

help.en: The Korea Tourism Organisation runs a travel hotline offering help in several languages, including English.
help.es: La Organización de Turismo de Corea tiene una línea de ayuda al viajero en varios idiomas, incluido el inglés.
help.quote: The Korea Tourism Organisation (KTO) operates a travel hotline to provide assistance in multiple languages, including English.

help.en: Call 1330 to reach the travel hotline.
help.es: Llama al 1330 para contactar la línea de ayuda al viajero.
help.quote: Call 1330 to contact the travel hotline.

help.en: The Danuri Call Centre (1577 1366) offers interpretation support to foreigners and is available 24/7.
help.es: El centro de llamadas Danuri (1577 1366) ofrece interpretación a extranjeros y atiende las 24 horas.

getting_in.en: Incheon International Airport (ICN), about 1 hour west of Seoul, is the country's largest airport.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Incheon (ICN), a una hora al oeste de Seúl, es el mayor del país.
getting_in.quote: Incheon International Airport (ICN IATA), about 1 hour west of Seoul, is the country's largest airport and is served by many international airlines.

getting_in.en: Incheon airport has a metro line to Seoul-Gimpo airport and Seoul Station, with express AREX taking 43 minutes.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Incheon tiene una línea de metro al aeropuerto de Gimpo y a la estación de Seúl; el AREX exprés tarda 43 minutos.
getting_in.quote: The airport has a metro line (express AREX 43 min and all-stop subway 56 min) that goes directly to both Seoul–Gimpo airport and Seoul Station.

getting_in.en: Seoul's Gimpo Airport (GMP) offers domestic flights to most South Korean cities.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Gimpo (GMP) en Seúl ofrece vuelos nacionales a la mayoría de las ciudades surcoreanas.
getting_in.quote: Seoul's Gimpo Airport (GMP IATA) offers domestic flights to most South Korean cities

getting_in.en: Busan's Gimhae International Airport (PUS) has international connections from East and Southeast Asia, Vladivostok, Guam and Saipan.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Gimhae en Busan (PUS) tiene conexiones internacionales desde Asia Oriental y Sudoriental, Vladivostok, Guam y Saipán.
getting_in.quote: Busan's Gimhae International Airport (PUS IATA) has international connections from East and Southeast Asia, as well as Vladivostok, Guam, and Saipan.

getting_in.en: Busan's International Passenger Terminal is the largest seaport and offers ferries mostly to and from Japan.
getting_in.es: La terminal internacional de pasajeros de Busan es el mayor puerto del país y ofrece ferris sobre todo hacia y desde Japón.
getting_in.quote: Busan's International Passenger Terminal is the largest seaport in the country and offers ferry rides mostly to and from Japan.

getting_in.en: Entering South Korea overland is not possible because of the situation with North Korea.
getting_in.es: No es posible entrar a Corea del Sur por tierra debido a la situación con Corea del Norte.
getting_in.quote: Due to the political and military situation with North Korea, entering South Korea overland is not possible.

getting_around.en: The T-money card is the most widely used transport smart card, valid on local buses, subways and T-money taxis nationwide.
getting_around.es: La tarjeta T-money es la tarjeta de transporte más usada y sirve en buses locales, metros y taxis con logo T-money en todo el país.
getting_around.quote: The most widely used transportation smart card is known as T-money (티머니 Ti-meoni) card. This can be used on local buses and subways throughout the country and taxis displaying the T-money logo.

getting_around.en: Google Maps does not give driving or walking directions in South Korea because of national security laws.
getting_around.es: Google Maps no da indicaciones para conducir ni caminar en Corea del Sur por las leyes de seguridad nacional.
getting_around.quote: As South Korean national security laws mandate that navigation processing be done only on local servers, Google Maps does not give driving or walking directions in South Korea

getting_around.en: The flagship high-speed KTX train runs from Seoul to Busan, Yeosu, Mokpo, Masan and Gangneung.
getting_around.es: El tren de alta velocidad KTX, el servicio estrella, va de Seúl a Busan, Yeosu, Mokpo, Masan y Gangneung.
getting_around.quote: South Korea's flagship service is the high speed Korea Train eXpress (KTX) with services from Seoul to Busan, Yeosu, Mokpo, Masan, and Gangneung.

getting_around.en: The Korail Pass is for non-resident foreigners staying under six months and allows unlimited Korail train travel for a set period.
getting_around.es: El Korail Pass es para extranjeros no residentes con estancias menores a seis meses y permite viajes ilimitados en trenes Korail por un periodo fijo.
getting_around.quote: The Korail Pass is a rail pass only for non-resident foreigners staying less than six months in Korea, allowing unlimited travel for a set period on any Korail train (including KTX) and including free seat reservation.

getting_around.en: Buses remain the main mode of national transport, connecting all cities and towns.
getting_around.es: Los buses siguen siendo el principal medio de transporte nacional y conectan todas las ciudades y pueblos.
getting_around.quote: Buses (버스 beoseu) remain the main mode of national transport, connecting all cities and towns.

getting_around.en: Jeju is the exception to easy train travel, and the Seoul-Jeju route is described as the busiest air route in the world.
getting_around.es: Jeju es la excepción al tren rápido, y la ruta Seúl-Jeju se describe como la ruta aérea más transitada del mundo.
getting_around.quote: The exception to this is Jeju; the Seoul-Jeju route being the busiest air route in the world.

money.en: The currency is the South Korean won (KRW), written ₩ or 원.
money.es: La moneda es el won surcoreano (KRW), escrito ₩ o 원.
money.quote: The currency of South Korea is the South Korean won, denoted by ₩ (ISO code: KRW) and written 원 (won) in the Korean language.

money.en: Credit card acceptance is very good, and all but the cheapest restaurants and motels accept Visa and MasterCard.
money.es: La aceptación de tarjetas es muy buena, y todos salvo los restaurantes y moteles más baratos aceptan Visa y MasterCard.
money.quote: Credit card acceptance in shops, hotels and other businesses on the other hand is very good, and all but the very cheapest restaurants and motels will accept Visa and MasterCard.

money.en: ATMs are everywhere, but using a foreign card in them is rather hit and miss.
money.es: Los cajeros están por todas partes, pero usar una tarjeta extranjera en ellos es incierto.
money.quote: ATMs are ubiquitous, although using a foreign card with them is rather hit and miss.

money.en: Tipping is not expected anywhere in South Korea and is not practiced by Koreans.
money.es: No se espera propina en ningún lugar de Corea del Sur y los coreanos no la practican.
money.quote: Tipping is not expected anywhere in South Korea and is not practiced by Koreans.

money.en: Many products carry 10% VAT, but foreign visitors can claim a refund when departing South Korea.
money.es: Muchos productos llevan un 10% de IVA, pero los visitantes extranjeros pueden pedir su reembolso al salir de Corea del Sur.
money.quote: Many products sold in South Korea will have 10% VAT added. However, foreign visitors can claim a refund on this tax when departing South Korea.

money.en: Bargaining is common at outdoor markets and applies to everything they offer.
money.es: Regatear es común en los mercados al aire libre y aplica a todo lo que ofrecen.
money.quote: Bargaining is common at outdoor markets and applies to everything they may have to offer.

etiquette.en: It is very important to remove your shoes in many places, and you are always expected to in someone's home.
etiquette.es: Es muy importante quitarse los zapatos en muchos lugares, y siempre se espera hacerlo en casa de alguien.
etiquette.quote: It is very important to remove your shoes when entering many places in Korea. You are always expected to take off your shoes in someone's home.

etiquette.en: Koreans bow to show respect when they meet and may also shake hands.
etiquette.es: Los coreanos se inclinan para mostrar respeto al encontrarse y también pueden dar la mano.
etiquette.quote: Koreans bow to each other to show their respect when they meet. They may also shake hands.

etiquette.en: When dining with Koreans, never pour your own drink but take the initiative to pour for others.
etiquette.es: Al comer con coreanos, nunca te sirvas tu propia bebida y sirve tú a los demás.
etiquette.quote: Never pour your own drink when dining with Koreans, but always take the initiative to pour for others.

etiquette.en: On public transport you are expected to give up your seat to someone older than you.
etiquette.es: En el transporte público se espera que cedas tu asiento a alguien mayor que tú.
etiquette.quote: In public transportation, you are always expected to give up your seat to someone older than you

etiquette.es: Los coreanos suelen comunicarse de forma indirecta.

etiquette.en: To get the most respect, dress smartly and conservatively and groom yourself well.
etiquette.es: Para obtener el mayor respeto, viste de forma elegante y conservadora y cuida tu aseo.
etiquette.quote: To get the most amount of respect, dress smartly and conservatively and groom yourself well.

connectivity.en: Mobile phone coverage is generally excellent, except in some remote mountainous areas.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil es generalmente excelente, salvo en algunas zonas montañosas remotas.
connectivity.quote: Mobile phone coverage is generally excellent, with the exception of some remote mountainous areas.

connectivity.en: You can get a prepaid SIM on arrival for ₩5,500 and must charge at least ₩10,000 on the spot.
connectivity.es: Puedes obtener una SIM prepago al llegar por ₩5,500 y debes recargar al menos ₩10,000 en el momento.
connectivity.quote: you can apply for a prepaid SIM immediately upon arrival. The fee for a prepaid SIM card is ₩5,500, and you have to charge at least ₩10,000 at the spot.

connectivity.en: Free public Wi-Fi is described as available everywhere, thanks to routers on public transportation.
connectivity.es: Se describe el wifi público gratuito como disponible en todas partes, gracias a routers en el transporte público.
connectivity.quote: Free public Wi-Fi is available everywhere, thanks to wireless routers installed on public transportation.

connectivity.en: KakaoTalk may sometimes be the only way to connect, since WhatsApp is not popular in South Korea.
connectivity.es: KakaoTalk a veces puede ser la única forma de contactar, ya que WhatsApp no es popular en Corea del Sur.
connectivity.quote: KakaoTalk may sometimes be the only way to connect, since internationally popular apps like WhatsApp are not popular in South Korea.

connectivity.en: The 1330 Korea Travel Phone is a 24-hour service offered in Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese.
connectivity.es: El 1330 Korea Travel Phone es un servicio de 24 horas en coreano, inglés, japonés y chino.
connectivity.quote: It is a 24-hour service and offered in Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese.
